corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The explicit skip-or-exit choice in a necessary guided flow preserves user intent; use priority3 without changing SHOULD.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Reversing an action and recovering work preserves user control over outcomes; use priority3 and retain SHOULD.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The supporting paragraph explicitly concerns intentions, permission rationale, and data disclosure; apply privacy and explicit-intent priority.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Information integrity and protection from misuse are security concerns; apply priority1 while retaining the general SHOULD.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Inclusive design explicitly includes accessibility from the start in the supporting paragraph; apply priority2 and retain SHOULD.

Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The source explicitly names voice, touch, and keyboard inputs. Make these discoverable through modality filters and use input/device priority5. Retain MAY; no requirement to support every input was introduced.

conditions: Remove elements that don't support the primary purpose.
Keep important things close by and focus on a useful experience.
Simplicity does not require minimalism.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Preserve the source distinction between simplicity and minimalism instead of treating all elements outside the primary purpose as automatically removable.

conditions: Use interaction, motion, sound, or visuals when they support the purpose.
Consider whether each interaction offers an opportunity to express the character of the design.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Remove an unsupported list of motion, sound, and visual techniques. Preserve the supporting consider qualifier without lowering the source-backed Create defining moments SHOULD.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The principle explicitly prioritizes safety and privacy. Use the highest applicable conflict priority rather than generic-principle priority7.

conditions: Preserve the primary task as the experience changes.
Try to support as many devices, types of interaction, and perspectives as possible.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Replace the inferred primary-task-preservation condition with the actual broad-support qualifier; this remains a contextual SHOULD, not a demand to support all devices.

statement.en: Prototype, test, refine, and iterate in real-world settings.

conditions: Use findings to improve both details and overall direction.

statement.en: Prototype early, experiment, refine, and iterate; test the product in real-world settings.
statement.ja: 早期に試作し、実験・改善・反復を行う。製品のテストは実際の利用環境で行う。

conditions: Be willing to discard approaches that do not work.
Use real-world testing to assess durability, reliability, and performance.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The real-world setting qualifies testing, not every prototype or refinement step. Preserve early prototyping, experimentation, iteration, and the testing purpose.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The explicit Make sure from-the-start intention requirement preserves informed user intent; retain MUST with priority3.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Permission rationale is an explicit privacy and informed-intent outcome under the repository decision policy; retain its request condition and MUST with priority3.

conditions: Make the disclosure understandable before people provide the data.
When gathering data, clearly explain what is collected and how it is used.

corrections.review_note: Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: Retain the conditional privacy-disclosure MUST and priority3. Remove a more specific before-user-provision timeline not stated in this supporting sentence; this does not override separately applicable consent guidance.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The explicit only-needed collection boundary is a privacy requirement; retain MUST and apply priority3.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The explicit protections against abuse, harm, and unintended consequences are security/safety requirements; retain MUST with priority1.
Re-reviewed 2026-09-08: The explicit accessibility-from-the-start outcome retains MUST under the repository decision policy; apply accessibility priority2.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Give people freedom to explore

statement.en: Let people explore without locking them into unnecessary flows or modes.
statement.ja: 不要なflowやmodeへ固定せず、人々が自由に探索できるようにする。

conditions: When guidance is necessary, let people skip or exit it.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized exploration and escape behavior at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Make mistakes reversible

statement.en: Make mistakes reversible without costing people's time or work.
statement.ja: 人々の時間や作業を失わせずにmistakeを元に戻せるようにする。

conditions: Provide a forgiving path back to the previous state.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized recovery and its time-and-work preservation outcome.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Be transparent about product behavior

statement.en: Be transparent about what the product does and why.
statement.ja: productが何をなぜ行うかについてtransparentにする。

conditions: Apply the separate atomic requirements for intent, permissions, and data disclosure.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Retained the umbrella principle at SHOULD and separated stronger explicit outcomes.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Keep people's information safe

statement.en: Protect the integrity and safety of people's information.

conditions: Apply the separate data-minimization and misuse-protection requirements.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Repaired the malformed statement and kept the umbrella principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Design inclusively

statement.en: Design inclusively for diverse experiences, perspectives, and needs.
statement.ja: 多様なexperience、perspective、needを含めて設計する。

conditions: Apply the separate accessibility-from-the-start requirement.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized inclusion while separating the explicit accessibility priority.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Consider varied input methods

statement.en: Consider voice, touch, keyboard, and other input methods.
statement.ja: voice、touch、keyboardなど複数のinput methodを検討する。

conditions: Choose methods that fit the platform, device, task, and person.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Preserved the source's Consider strength at MAY.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Include only what's necessary

statement.en: Include only what is necessary for a focused, useful experience.
statement.ja: focusedでusefulなexperienceに必要なものだけを含める。

conditions: Remove elements that don't support the primary purpose.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized the necessary-content outcome at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Create defining moments

statement.en: Create moments that express the product's character.

conditions: Use interaction, motion, sound, or visuals when they support the purpose.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Concretized the expressive outcome without mandating decoration.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Act in people's best interests

statement.ja: 人々のbest interestを優先して行動する。

conditions: Prioritize safety, privacy, and transparency when priorities compete.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted responsibility principle at conservative SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Adapt to diverse contexts and needs

statement.en: Adapt to diverse contexts, devices, interactions, and perspectives.

conditions: Preserve the primary task as the experience changes.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted flexibility principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Experiment and iterate

statement.en: Prototype, test, refine, and iterate in real-world settings.

conditions: Use findings to improve both details and overall direction.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Activated the omitted iterative-craft principle at SHOULD.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Make app intentions clear from the start

statement.en: Make the app's intentions clear from the first interaction.
statement.ja: 最初のinteractionからappのintentionを明確にする。

conditions: People need this context before deciding whether to continue.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit from-the-start transparency outcome as a user-intent MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Explain permission requests

statement.en: When asking for permission, provide a clear rationale.
statement.ja: permissionを求めるとき、明確なrationaleを提供する。

conditions: Explain why the app needs the requested access.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified permission rationale as a privacy and informed-intent MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Disclose data collection and use

statement.en: When collecting data, disclose what you collect and how you use it.
statement.ja: dataを収集するとき、収集内容と利用方法を開示する。

conditions: Make the disclosure understandable before people provide the data.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Split the privacy disclosure outcome from the same supporting source sentence.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Minimize data collection

statement.en: Collect only the data the product needs to function.
statement.ja: productのfunctionに必要なdataだけを収集する。

conditions: Do not expand collection beyond functional need.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the source's only-needed data-minimization boundary as MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Protect data from misuse and harm

statement.en: Protect data against foreseeable misuse, harm, abuse, and unintended consequences.
statement.ja: foreseeableなmisuse、harm、abuse、unintended consequenceからdataを保護する。

conditions: Evaluate both intentional abuse and unintended downstream effects.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit information-safety outcome as a security MUST.

HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.title: Prioritize accessibility from the start

statement.en: Treat accessibility as a priority from the start.
statement.ja: 最初からaccessibilityをpriorityとして扱う。

conditions: Integrate accessibility into initial product and interaction decisions.
HIG-GETTING-STARTED-DESIGN-PRINCIPLES-00.review_note: Classified the explicit from-the-start accessibility priority as MUST.

prior_batch_metadata.review_method: Rendered Apple HIG Design principles introduction, eight principle sections, supporting context, resources, and change log were reviewed; two completed live renders matched the stored source hash.
prior_batch_metadata.review_note: Expanded Design principles from 23 to 39 active atomic rules, retained general principles as decision tools, and reviewed six atomic accessibility, privacy, security, permission, or explicit-user-intent outcomes as MUST.

review_method: Root reviewed22 rules and the introduction, and verified helper findings; one helper independently reviewed17 rules. All eight principle sections were covered. Six manual sentence traces were resolved separately from DOM-row matching, without changing their hashes. Presence and semantic approval are separate checks.
unverified: The general source-inspection CLI compares DOM row hashes, not arbitrary sentence fragments. Its six unmatched candidates for this page are resolved by the supplemental evidence, not missing guidance.
General principles have no single right application. The six retained MUST outcomes follow the repository normalization policy, not an authoritative Apple compliance certification.
Linked documents, images, media, and exact old full-page prose diffs were not reviewed.

extraction_verification.method: Isolated re-extraction reproduces every canonical rule file and stable-ID registry byte-for-byte.
